_comment: Human-set release metadata. published_at is part of the content hash, so set it once per intended release.
title: Rare Disease Atlas: ion-channel neurodevelopmental disorders (hackathon release)
limitations: All records were accepted in one blanket decision by the project owner (a-pihlgren) on 2026-10-04 without per-record inspection; structural checks still applied. This is not expert or scientific validation.
Built only from structured sources (GenCC, Orphanet, HPO annotations, Mondo, NIH RePORTER, ClinicalTrials.gov). No claims were extracted from literature text in this release.
Most contexts are disease-level with mechanism unknown; the three gain-of-function subgroups come only from Orphanet's controlled association type.
